cl.x: Provide Sika® WT-200 P where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.04).
Sika® WT-200 P is a combined water resisting and crystalline waterproofing admixture used to reduce the permeability of concrete and to enhance the self-healing abilities of the concrete.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.l: Sika® WT-200 P has been specifically formulated to produce high quality waterproof concrete. Sika® WT- 200 P treated concrete is used as a part of the Sika® Watertight Concrete System. Sika® WT-200 P can be used in any below / in / above ground watertight structures such as:
s: Basements
Parking garages
Utility / plant rooms
Tunnels
Swimming pools
Water retaining structures
Dams
Waste water treatment structures
Underground commercial facilities (malls, transportation hubs etc.)

cl.x: Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

cl.l: Sika® WT-200 P consists of a mixture of cements, amino alcohols and fillers. These active materials will form non-soluble materials throughout the pore and capillary structure of the concrete and seal the concrete permanently against penetration of water and other liquids. In addition the special formula and ingredients of Sika® WT-200 P enhances the self-healing properties of concrete and will improve the ability to heal cracks in concrete. Sika® WT-200 P has the following characteristics and benefits:
s: Reduced water penetration under pressure
Reduced water absorption
Enhancement of self-healing properties of the concrete
Improvement in resistance against chemical attack
Reduced vapour transmission
Higher compressive strength
Composition: Mixture of cements, amino alcohols and fillers
Appearance and colour: Grayish powder
Bulk density: ~750 kg/m³
r: Mixture of cements, amino alcohols and fillers

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Technical Information > Concreting guidance
cl.x: The standard rules of good concreting practice, concerning production and placing, are to be followed. Laboratory trials shall be carried out before concreting on site, especially when using a new mix design or producing new concrete components. Fresh concrete must be cured properly and curing applied as early as possible.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Technical Information > Concrete mix design
s: For waterproof concrete: Concrete mix design depends on local requirements and / or local standards for watertight concrete systems.

For Sika® Watertight Concrete: Sika® WT-200 P has been formulated for use in concrete with a minimum binder content of 350 kg/m³ and a maximum w/b-ratio of 0.45. Depending on the specific mix design the dosage of HRW /superplasticizer has to be evaluated in order to achieve a consistency ≥110 mm (slump test AS1012.3.1)
Laboratory trials are always recommended to evaluate and confirm actual water reduction and consistency class.
Packaging: 1.75 kg pulpable bags (6 bags/sealed plastic bucket)
Shelf life: 12 months from date of production if stored in unopened and undamaged original sealed containers.
Storage conditions: Storage at temperatures between 5 °C and 35 °C. Protect from direct sunlight, moisture, frost and contamination.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Information > Dispensing
cl.l: Sika® WT-200 P is added at the time of batching to the concrete.Depending on the operation it can be dosed
s: At the dry batching plant : add Sika® WT-200 P either to the gauging / mixing water to form a very thin slurry and add it into the truck barrel or load it along with the concrete components. Then mix thoroughly for about 60 seconds/m³ . Do not add Sika® WT-200 P to wet concrete.
At the wet batching plant (mixer) : dispense Sika® WT-200 P and the concrete components together, mixing as per the internal production procedures.
tr: The w/b-ratio and consistency control remains the responsibility of the concrete producer.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Information > Compatibility
cl.x: Sika® WT-200 P may be combined with many other Sika products. Note: Always conduct trials before combining products in specific mixes and contact Sika technical service for more information and advice.
When using Sika® WT-200 P a suitable mix design has to be taken into account and local material sources shall be tested.
Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
